name: Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai
description: Around the Oval Maidan, a broad green in southern Mumbai's Fort district, two eras of the city face each other. On the east side stand Victorian Gothic landmarks such as the High Court, Mumbai University and the Rajabai Clock Tower, with verandas and balconies suited to the climate. On the west, pastel Art Deco apartment blocks and the Eros Cinema show off the "Indo-Deco" style.
